context: Tests whether the TDD skill uses fast-check for property-based testing of core logic, with properties for round-trip, total preservation, and non-negative constraints preferred over example-only tests.

checklist.name: Fast-check used
checklist.description: fast-check library is imported and used with fc.property/fc.assert or equivalent

checklist.name: Round-trip property
checklist.description: A round-trip or algebraic property is tested for add/subtract operations

checklist.name: Total preservation
checklist.description: A property test verifies that the sum of split parts always equals the original amount

checklist.name: Non-negative parts
checklist.description: A property test verifies all parts returned by split are non-negative integers

checklist.name: Properties over examples
checklist.description: Core logic is tested primarily through property-based tests, not just hardcoded examples
